en.html:
An indictment.

A condemnation.

She knew.
What I had done, what I had done to the person she cherished—she knew.

Konatsu Kurusuno's sentence, proclaiming my guilt for killing Yuhi Nitta.
An assertion of absolute, flawless justice.

ja.html:
弾劾。

　断罪。

　彼女は知っているのだ。
　俺が何をしたのか、彼女の大切な人に何をしたのか、
知っているのだ。

　あれは新田雄飛殺害の罪科を鳴らす、来栖野小夏の
裁断宣告。
　絶対無欠の正義表明。

Save her.
Save her.
Save her.

I reached toward the innocent girl.

Come this way!

A little. Only a little.
Bring your body closer to me—
